item.title: on schema graphs
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on schema graphs, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Schema graphs shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
